sections.view: D10~D14 section, with top flange, web and bottom flange plan views

lessons: Segment 4 is sheet J-45 (アーチリブ（その4）, 縮尺 図示). The number is in the rightmost title block cell. The sheet uses the same three stacked plan views as J-43 and J-44.

Segment 4 callouts: 1-TOP PL 1700x28x8254, 2-RIB PL 220x22x8244 (top flange). 1-BOTT PL 1574x28x8126, with 2-RIB PL 220x22 of lengths 2548, 1214 and 2953 (bottom flange). 2-WEB PL 1330x23x8247 (web). All are SM490YB.

The depth comes from the D10~D14 section: overall 1250, web 1200, webs at 1600 centre-to-centre inside 1700 overall. The web is 1200 deep at both ends, so the depth does not taper here and the web PL width of 1330 is the curved width.
The axis length is the 8190 dimension labelled アーチリブ軸線上 on the web view. The plate lengths 8254, 8247 and 8126 are not the axis length.

Web ribs: the section dimension 3@400=1200 gives four horizontal rib rows per web, and the web elevation shows several dashed rib lines. Report web_rib count 4 per web, the same as segment 5 with the same 1200 depth. The 2- or 4- prefixes in the web list count pieces per panel, so do not use them as the per-web count.
Flange ribs are 2 per flange (2-RIB PL). The web rib list has circled numbers 1-13, and the pieces vary in length.
The digits 6 and 8 are easy to confuse in this scan. Check each value against its neighbouring dimensions, for example 8126.4 and 8190.
